restaurantName: Be Our Guest: The Enchanted Rose Afternoon Tea
bio: Afternoon Tea Awards 2024 Winner - Best Themed Afternoon Tea  Homage Restaurant at The Waldorf Hilton invites you to join them for a magical Afternoon Tea experience, inspired by the beautiful story of Beauty and the Beast. Expect enchanting elements, Mrs. Potts and Chip in a breath-taking setting filled with history and accompanied by delightful harp music.  Their Be Our Guest Afternoon Tea menu is thoughtfully curated by Executive Chef Luke Rayment-Blakey to celebrate the marriage of bold flavours and delicate techniques, playfully incorporating some of the much-loved scenes and characters with a Waldorf twist.  Whether you are celebrating an occasion or seeking an indulgent treat, enjoy their selection of freshly cut sandwiches and savouries before tucking into warm scones with clotted cream and jam.  Finish with sweet treats and your choosing from their fabulous range of speciality teas. Creating a real sense of occasion, their popular Afternoon Tea is skillfully prepared, served with precision and elegance in suitably grand surroundings to indulge in the great British tradition.
pageTitle: Be Our Guest: The Enchanted Rose Afternoon Tea
